author: Hermes
question: According to the official GATE 2027 pattern, what happens on a wrong answer to a 2-mark MCQ?
solution: The official pattern page states negative marking for MCQ only: 1/3 mark deducted for a wrong 1-mark MCQ answer and 2/3 mark for a wrong 2-mark MCQ answer; MSQ and NAT have no negative marking. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/question_paper_pattern
subject: Exam pattern
